item.name: Normal
item.summary: The default grassy island with no weather effects and no biome-locked auras.
item.howItAppears: Active whenever no other biome is rolling; the biome system rerolls every second.

item.name: Windy
item.summary: A cool wind sweeps the island while leaves whip off the trees.
item.howItAppears: Spawns naturally from the every-second biome roll.
item.nativeAuras: Wind, Flow, Stormal, Vortex, Aviator, Stormal : Hurricane, Maelstrom

item.name: Snowy
item.summary: Snow and cold cover the map in white.
item.howItAppears: Spawns naturally from the every-second biome roll.

item.name: Rainy
item.summary: Showers and gray fog roll through, powering water auras.
item.howItAppears: Spawns naturally from the every-second biome roll.
item.nativeAuras: Evanescent, Poseidon, Aquaria, Sailor, Sailor : Flying Dutchman, Sharkyn, Abyssal Hunter, Lumenpool, and more

item.name: Sandstorm
item.summary: A harsh sandstorm blankets the map in dust.
item.howItAppears: Spawns naturally from the every-second biome roll.
item.nativeAuras: Gilded, Jackpot, Gilded : Crowned, Anubis, Outlaw, Atlas

item.name: Hell
item.summary: Chaotic red energy overtakes the world.
item.howItAppears: Spawns naturally from the every-second biome roll.
item.nativeAuras: Undead, Undead : Devil, Hades, Hellbound, Bloodlust, Felled, Pythios

item.name: Starfall
item.summary: A dark blue sky with stars pouring down.
item.howItAppears: Spawns naturally; each Starfall spawn also has a 1 in 100 chance to become Singularity instead.
item.nativeAuras: Starlight, StarRider, Astral, Orion, Stargazer, Starlight : Kunzite, Sirius, Starborn, and more

item.name: Heaven
item.summary: A divine golden sky opens above the island.
item.howItAppears: Spawns naturally from the every-second biome roll.
item.nativeAuras: Divinus : Angel, Hope, Divinus : Guardian, Faith, Dominion, Icarus, Oculus, Archangel, and more

item.name: Corruption
item.summary: Poisonous pollution spreads across the map.
item.howItAppears: Spawns naturally from the every-second biome roll.
item.nativeAuras: Hazard, Corrosive, Hazard : Rays, Parasite, Symbiosis, Impeached, Monarch

item.name: Null
item.summary: The map fades to gray as mist blocks your vision.
item.howItAppears: Spawns naturally from the every-second biome roll.
item.nativeAuras: Flowed, Nihility, Shiftlock, Undefined, Empty, Breakthrough (Aura)

item.name: Glitched
item.summary: The world breaks into error textures and corrupted terrain.
item.howItAppears: Spawns naturally from the every-second biome roll; the rarest naturally rolling biome tier starts here.

item.name: Dreamspace
item.summary: A sleepy pastel dream world takes over the island.
item.howItAppears: The second rarest biome; it can also appear from biome items.

item.name: Cyberspace
item.summary: A digital grid world hosted by Jake, with a 2x breakthrough multiplier.
item.howItAppears: Cannot spawn naturally; it has a 1 in 5,000 chance when using a Strange Controller or Biome Randomizer.
item.nativeAuras: Forbidden, Player, Metabytes, Player : Respawn, Virtual, Antivirus, Matrix, Virtual : Fatal Error, and more

item.name: Singularity
item.summary: A collapsing void that pulls everything in, home of Limbo-grade auras.
item.howItAppears: Replaces Starfall 1 in 100 times whenever Starfall spawns, whether naturally or from biome items.
item.nativeAuras: Constella, Pleiades, Pulsar, Comet, Astronaut, Galaxy, Vega, Centurion, and more
